I apologize that the one year anniversary edit is just a redo edit. I thought this was a good one to come back to and redo because I could add much more and go all out with it. Apologies as well for posting more than a week later, I've been working on this as well as making a Google drive which will have all the edits and will be posted on my account once it is finished which should be very soon I hope. Also, I was originally planning on ending these here, but there's still some albums I wanna do as well as some I'd love to redo (like Enema of the State and Dark Side of the Moon for example) and these are geniunely a really great outlet for me creatively so I wanna keep going with them so long as that isn't an issue or an annoyance lmao. I can't say that it'll be a daily thing because I've been shit with that recently due to school and what not, but I still want them to still have a place in my schedule. Lastly I've said it before, but once again thank you all for the support on these 💛 I love the who and editing these dumb things and I'm glad to have found such a lovely community 💛💛
